name: Cherry Blossom Survival House
description: A small survival house in pink cherry planks with a stone slab roof and a blossom tree growing over the top. Grass stairs lead up to the door, with a covered work porch on stilts at the side. Cherry wood and stone keep it cheap. Drop it anywhere in a cherry grove.
